spans.s:
(उ) घृषु r. 1st cl. (घर्षति)
To grind or pound.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Ground, rubbed, pounded.
2 Frayed, grazed, rubbed off.
E.
घृष to rub, क्त aff.

m. (-ष्टिः)
A hog; also गृष्टि.
f. (-ष्टिः)
1 A plant, commonly Varāhakrāntī, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.)
2 Grinding, pounding.
3 Emulation, contest.
E.
घृष to grind, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-ष्विः)
A hog.
E.
घृष to rub, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
